root_cause: Kafka consumer rebalance caused delayed payment event processing.
resolution: Restarted affected consumers and increased Kafka partition capacity.
engineer_feedback: Restart worked; rebalance triggered by deploy.

root_cause: Redis connection pool exhaustion under peak load.
resolution: Increased connection pool size and added a circuit breaker.
engineer_feedback: Pool sizing was too low for peak traffic.

symptoms: Kafka consumer lag climbing after deploy
root_cause: Consumer rebalance triggered by a rolling deployment.
resolution: Restarted consumers and staggered the rollout.
engineer_feedback: Staggering the rollout prevented recurrence.

root_cause: Unassigned shards after a node restart.
resolution: Reallocated shards and increased disk watermark thresholds.
engineer_feedback: Disk watermark was hit during reindex.

root_cause: Consumer group rebalance during an autoscaling event.
resolution: Restarted affected consumers and tuned session timeout.
engineer_feedback: Autoscaling caused the rebalance; tuned heartbeat.

root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion after a traffic surge.
resolution: Increased pool size and added connection timeouts.
engineer_feedback: Pool was undersized for flash sale traffic.

root_cause: Upstream service crashed after a bad deployment.
resolution: Rolled back the deployment and restarted upstream pods.
engineer_feedback: Rollback resolved it immediately.

root_cause: Third-party SMS provider degraded.
resolution: Failed over to secondary provider and added retries.
engineer_feedback: Provider outage; failover worked.

root_cause: Consumer rebalance following a configuration change during deployment.
resolution: Restarted consumers and reverted the config change.
engineer_feedback: Config change altered consumer group id.

root_cause: Memory leak in a caching layer introduced by a release.
resolution: Rolled back the release and patched the cache eviction.
engineer_feedback: Cache never evicted expired entries.

root_cause: Redis connection pool exhaustion during a credential-stuffing spike.
resolution: Increased pool size and enabled rate limiting.
engineer_feedback: Attack traffic exhausted the pool.

root_cause: Connection pool exhaustion after a slow query regression.
resolution: Added an index and increased pool size.
engineer_feedback: Missing index caused slow queries to hold connections.

root_cause: Unassigned replica shards after a node eviction.
resolution: Forced shard reallocation and added a replica.
engineer_feedback: Node eviction during autoscale.

root_cause: Upstream readiness probe misconfigured after deployment.
resolution: Fixed the readiness probe and redeployed.
engineer_feedback: Probe timeout too aggressive.

root_cause: Rebalance caused by scaling consumers during a deployment.
resolution: Restarted consumers and pinned consumer count during deploys.
engineer_feedback: Pinning consumers during deploy stopped the churn.

root_cause: Supplier API rate-limited our requests.
resolution: Added backoff and request batching.
engineer_feedback: We exceeded the supplier rate limit.

root_cause: Inefficient serialization introduced by a release caused CPU saturation.
resolution: Rolled back and optimized the serializer.
engineer_feedback: Regex compile in a hot path pinned CPU.

root_cause: A deployment opened extra connections per request, exhausting the pool.
resolution: Reverted the change and reused a shared connection.
engineer_feedback: New code opened a connection per call.

root_cause: Apple Push Notification service latency.
resolution: Added a queue and retry with jitter.
engineer_feedback: Upstream provider latency, transient.

root_cause: A deployment reduced the Redis pool size by mistake.
resolution: Restored the pool configuration and redeployed.
engineer_feedback: Config regression halved the pool.

root_cause: Consumer rebalance storm triggered by a rolling deployment.
resolution: Restarted consumers, staggered rollout, increased partitions.
engineer_feedback: Classic deploy-induced rebalance.

root_cause: Unassigned shards after a rolling ES upgrade.
resolution: Enabled shard allocation and waited for green.
engineer_feedback: Allocation was disabled during upgrade.

root_cause: Upstream pods OOMKilled due to a memory limit lowered in deployment.
resolution: Raised memory limits and rolled forward.
engineer_feedback: Deploy lowered the memory limit.

root_cause: Unbounded in-memory list introduced by a release.
resolution: Rolled back and bounded the collection.
engineer_feedback: List grew without limit.

root_cause: CoreDNS pod under-provisioned during a traffic spike.
resolution: Scaled CoreDNS and increased cache TTL.
engineer_feedback: DNS could not keep up with lookups.

root_cause: Consumer rebalance after a deployment changed max.poll settings.
resolution: Restarted consumers and tuned max.poll.interval.
engineer_feedback: max.poll too low caused eviction.

root_cause: A long-running analytics query held connections.
resolution: Moved analytics to a read replica.
engineer_feedback: Analytics starved the primary pool.

root_cause: A deployment enabled verbose logging in a hot path.
resolution: Disabled debug logging and redeployed.
engineer_feedback: Debug logging pinned CPU.

root_cause: SMTP provider throttling.
resolution: Added a send queue and provider failover.
engineer_feedback: Provider throttled bulk sends.

root_cause: Canary deployment caused a partial consumer rebalance.
resolution: Completed the rollout quickly and restarted consumers.
engineer_feedback: Canary split the consumer group briefly.

root_cause: A full reindex saturated CPU during peak hours.
resolution: Throttled reindex and scheduled it off-peak.
engineer_feedback: Reindex should not run at peak.

root_cause: A bad config in deployment caused an upstream crash loop.
resolution: Rolled back the deployment.
engineer_feedback: Rollback fixed the crash loop.

root_cause: Event listeners not deregistered, leaking memory.
resolution: Rolled back and fixed listener cleanup.
engineer_feedback: Listeners accumulated over time.

root_cause: Batch job opened too many parallel connections.
resolution: Limited batch concurrency and reused connections.
engineer_feedback: Batch concurrency was unbounded.

root_cause: Consumer rebalance triggered by a deployment restart of all pods.
resolution: Adopted a rolling restart with maxUnavailable=1.
engineer_feedback: Restarting all pods at once caused the rebalance.

symptoms: PostgreSQL connections remain saturated after traffic falls
root_cause: A transaction leak kept connections checked out after request failures.
resolution: Increased the connection pool limit and restarted the order service.
engineer_feedback: The pool increase and restart did not resolve the incident; leaked transactions continued exhausting connections.

symptoms: Search results omit recently updated products
root_cause: A producer began sending a keyword field as an object, conflicting with the existing index mapping.
resolution: Cleared the application search cache and retried the indexing batch.
engineer_feedback: Cache clearing and retrying did not resolve indexing failures because the incompatible mapping remained.

root_cause: The push provider credential was revoked during a key rotation, but the active secret reference was not updated.
resolution: Increased retry attempts and queue retention for provider requests.
engineer_feedback: More retries did not resolve the incident; requests continued receiving 401 until the secret reference was corrected.

symptoms: Failures began after identity-provider configuration change
root_cause: The configured JWT issuer URL no longer matched the issuer claim in newly issued tokens.
resolution: Flushed the authentication service JWKS cache and restarted its pods.
engineer_feedback: Flushing JWKS cache and restarting pods did not resolve authentication failures; issuer configuration still mismatched.

symptoms: Consumer repeatedly restarts at the same event offset
root_cause: A malformed inventory event could not be deserialized and repeatedly stopped the consumer partition.
resolution: Restarted the inventory consumers and replayed the event batch from the last checkpoint.
engineer_feedback: Restart and replay did not resolve the incident because the malformed event continued blocking the partition.
